errors.billingOff: Billing is not enabled on this installation. Contact support.
errors.checkoutFailed: I could not open the payment screen. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.invalidReceipt: Invalid receipt. Use an image or PDF up to 8 MB.
errors.noSubscription: You do not have a subscription to manage yet.
errors.paymentMethodExists: A payment method with that name already exists.
errors.paymentMethodInUse: There are payments recorded with this method. Disable it to take it out of the picker without touching history.
errors.paymentMethodSystem: Built-in methods cannot be deleted — disable it to take it out of the picker.
errors.recurrenceAmountLocked: The amount comes from the plan. Pick a plan — or ask for permission to set the amount.
errors.installmentInvalid: Invalid installment plan: enter the total amount and 2 to 48 installments.
errors.chargeAlreadyAtGateway: This charge was already created at the gateway. Cancel the invoice there before creating another.
errors.chargeNotOpen: This charge is not open — there is nothing to collect.
errors.chargeGateway: The gateway did not accept the charge.
errors.chargeNotAtGateway: This charge was not created at the gateway — there is no invoice to refund.
errors.chargeRefund: The gateway did not accept the refund.
errors.chargeNoLink: This charge has no payment link to send.
errors.personNoEmail: This person has no e-mail on file.
errors.chargeEmail: The e-mail could not be sent right now.
errors.chargeHasPayments: This charge has money received. Delete the payment (or refund it) before removing it.
errors.chargeGatewayCancel: The gateway refused to cancel the invoice, so the charge stays open here. If it has already been paid, the way out is a refund.
errors.chargeGatewayDelete: The gateway refused to delete the invoice, so the charge stays here.

finance.recurrenceCanceledAtGateway: Subscription cancelled at the payment gateway.
